Strategy: Strong scaled extended awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and twice the item lose a penalty equal to the full item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that extended band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by firmly avoiding medium leftovers, but may fail if it overuses roomy bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= 2 * item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Strong scaled extended awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, 2*item] by item, exact fit highest.
